unparsed_lines: With approval by the program office, students should follow the curriculum of one of the following Mathematics Tracks: Pure Mathematics (Advanced) Track, Applied Mathematics Track, Statistics Track and complete all of its requirements excluding the capstone project requirement, which should be fulfilled by both SCIE 3500 and SCIE 4500 only. For students approved to follow the Applied Mathematics Track and Statistics Track, they must choose MATH 2431 which is listed in the Track Requirements; while for those who follow the Pure Mathematics (Advanced) Track, they should take MATH 2431 as an additional required course. | 27-34
